summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Qualister - Gestión Comercial prototype. All core functionality working as expected. This is a frontend-only prototype with in-memory session management (no backend, no persistence).

backend_issues.note: No backend exists in this project - this is a frontend-only prototype as per requirements.

notes: All demo notices and 'Dato de demostración' labels are present as required
Only 'Usuario de Ventas' profile is visible (no other profiles shown)
Session is in-memory only - direct URL navigation to /ventas/** redirects to /login (EXPECTED BEHAVIOR)
Console shows only CDN-related errors (Cloudflare RUM), no application errors
